lines.text: Lines sixty-seven and sixty-eight: driving and turning share the grip, scaled as one, so paths stay straight.
Line sixty-nine: total. The inner hypot is driving. Alpha times base radius is turning. The outer hypot is the long side.
Here, ten point four nine and two point eight seven make ten point eight eight.
Line seventy: is that more than traction accel? Yes.
Line seventy-one: scale is traction accel over total. Zero point nine one nine.
Lines seventy-two to seventy-four multiply a x, a y and alpha by that one scale: nine point six four, zero, seven point three five. Check three.
Lines seventy-six and seventy-seven build the answer: current, plus acceleration times d t.
V x: three point six plus nine point six four times zero point zero two. Three point seven nine.
Omega: one plus seven point three five times zero point zero two. One point one five. V y stays zero.
That's the fastest change the robot can really make this loop. The next loop starts from here.
